name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Automatically import bank and credit-card transactions from SimpleFin, with correct balances, pending reconciliation, and internal-transfer linking.

release.notes: Every spending category is now selectable in the addon, not just ones with a budget or spending, and each shows Wealthfolio's own icon and colour with subcategories grouped under their parent. Telegram reports are clean by default — decorative emoji removed, state markers kept — with an optional per-category glyph and a new toggle to break subcategories out under their parent. The companion also reports its version so a mismatched deployment is visible.
